worldcombat.skill.shadowpunch.summary: The user stands still while a shadow runs from its feet into the target's shadow and a fist rises out of the target's own shadow; because the fist starts where the target stands, it cannot be anticipated, so it never misses. Grounding grabs and drags the target toward the user.
worldcombat.skill.shadowpunch.use.0: Raise a fist out of the target's own shadow
worldcombat.skill.shadowpunch.use.1: Hit a distant target without moving
worldcombat.skill.shadowpunch.use.2: Grab and drag a target with the shadow
worldcombat.skill.shadowpunch.descriptio: A contact punch rising out of the target's shadow for about %1$s physical damage; the target's Defence, type match-up and criticals settle on the hit.

The shadow creeps along the ground from the user's feet into a target shadow within %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks/tick, and the fist only rises once it arrives; if the target is gone by then, the punch hits only empty air.
worldcombat.skill.shadowpunch.hold.on: Grounding: on a hit the fist grabs the target and drags it %1$s blocks toward the user, but the punch is about 15%% lighter.
worldcombat.skill.shadowpunch.hold.off: Ambush: no drag, a pure contact punch about 18% heavier.
worldcombat.skill.shadowpunch.timing: Cast on an enemy within %1$s blocks; after a %2$s s wind-up it costs %4$s PP to launch, then %3$s s recovery and %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.shadowpunch.growth.0: At level %1$s: punch power %2$s and reach %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.shadowpunch.growth.1: At level %1$s: punch power %2$s and drag %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.shadowpunch.preference: On (Grounding): on a hit the fist grabs the target and drags it toward the user, but the punch is about 15% lighter. Off (Ambush): no drag, about 18% heavier.
The user only punches at targets within this distance; larger values reach further.
On: an airborne enemy is a lower priority, because the shadow crawls along the ground; off: ignore whether the target is on the ground.
